about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A brief introduction
about.description: Hi! I’m Fabrizio, a Full-Stack Developer with a strong passion for Front-End and mobile development. I’ve had the chance to work on several ambitious projects, including “Campania in Salute”, an app that allows citizens to manage their healthcare directly from home. I took part in its design, development, and delivery — and it’s definitely one of the projects I’m most proud of. I love working with Vue.js (fast, flexible, and fun to use!) and I have experience building web apps with Ionic + Vue, as well as developing tools with Flask + Python (like a custom printing software for ESC/POS). Lately, I’ve been focusing on migrating legacy projects into modern solutions, building custom PWA that are responsive on every device. Always curious and eager to learn, I’ve also explored Docker and DevOps technologies to round out my skill set, along with backend development using Node.js. In short: I love building, innovating, and growing while embracing new challenges with enthusiasm
